decision.observation: 11:50 am; the scythe cleared grass south of the farmer on the sandy path west of the house; bush row and pines lie further south; stones and a small pine dot the path.
decision.hypothesis: The pond lies south past this bush band (day-12 sightings had water below the yard), so cutting and walking south should reach the north bank.
decision.memory: Toolbar: 2 hoe, 5 scythe (Fiber 20), 6 rod, 7 seeds(15). Day-8 Sunfish bit in the evening (~8:40 pm) with bobber deep at ~(0.78,0.72); day 12 cast into the pond landed at ~(0.55,0.71) but drew no bites (likely shallow west rim). Bed placed indoors and sleeps fine ('Yes' at ~(0.056,0.77)).
